instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about your family and a shopping list. Use we/they, are, plural nouns, my/your/his/her, and have/has.
